listing.name: THREAT DETECTED
listing.aiSummary: Adds a challenging enemy faction or scenario that has been balanced to be beatable.

description: Introduces a threat with specific mechanics involving Fabricators. The latest version prioritizes reaching two Fabricators, causes them to explode if more than two exist, and caps production at roughly double the fleet's expected DP.
